title: Providers
description: A bundle of healthcare provider records. The Providers wrapper holds a 'provider' array. To use the inner provider as a MongoDB $jsonSchema collection validator, target '#/definitions/provider' and replace 'type' with 'bsonType' throughout. Required fields: npi, loaded_at. Every other field is optional. Patterns and enums constrain the shape of values that are present.

provider.description: ChatHealthy.AI's proprietary provider record. It contains an array of provider records. May be empty.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: A healthcare provider record sourced from the NPPES NPI Registry, enriched with per-address county / urban data and proprietary classification flags. Required: npi (NPPES business key) and loaded_at (dispatcher-stamped at message dispatch).

_id.description: MongoDB ObjectId — auto-assigned on insert. Omit on write; always present on read.

npi.description: National Provider Identifier — 10-digit string, globally unique, issued by CMS. Never numeric; leading zeros are significant. THE record's business key.

loaded_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp stamped by the ChatHealthyDataPipelineProcessor. This timestamp represents the moment when the first raw record JSON is constructed.

load_id.description: Pipeline run identifier that wrote this record (parent orchestration's instance_id). Provenance — use npi as the stable identifier across runs.

record_id.description: Sequential integer assigned within a single pipeline run. Unique within one run but NOT globally unique across runs — use npi as the stable identifier.

entity_type_code.description: NPI entity type. '1' = individual practitioner. '2' = organization (hospital, pharmacy, group practice, etc.).

provider_enumeration_date.description: Date the NPI was issued by CMS. Format: MM/DD/YYYY (as received from NPPES CSV; not converted to ISO 8601).

last_update_date.description: Date the NPI record was last updated in the NPPES registry. Format: MM/DD/YYYY.

certification_date.description: Date the provider last certified their NPI record with CMS. Format: MM/DD/YYYY.

active.description: Inactivity event log for this NPI. OPTIONAL: absence = the provider is currently active AND has never had an inactivity incident in NPPES. PRESENT = the provider is currently inactive OR has been inactive at some point in the past (even if later reactivated). Each entry records one deactivation or reactivation event with the NPPES date. The current active state is computed by an evaluator function that walks the event log (latest deactivated/reactivated determines current status); the schema records the events, the function makes the call. Subsumes the former top-level npi_deactivation_date / npi_reactivation_date fields — their data lives in this event log.

date.description: Event date (MM/DD/YYYY) as reported by NPPES.

is_active.description: Provider's active state AFTER this event. event='deactivated' yields false; event='reactivated' yields true. Default true if absent (a default that satisfies the conceptual 'absence means active' contract; in practice this field is required on every event so the default rarely applies).

source.description: Where this event was learned (typically 'nppes_deactivation_date' or 'nppes_reactivation_date').

addresses.description: Unified address array. Replaces the previous separate practice_address + mailing_address fields. Exactly one entry has address_type='business' (the NPPES mailing/billing address); one or more entries have address_type='practice' (the primary practice location from the main NPPES file plus any secondary locations attached from the NPPES Practice Location Reference File pl_pfile_*.csv). County + urban enrichment is carried on every address entry regardless of type.

taxonomies.description: Provider specialty taxonomy codes (NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy). Each type-1 provider has at least one NUCC code. Each entry is {code, code_label} -- the labels-alongside-codes rule (LLD v39 sec. 7.1). The primary designator is stored top-level as primary_taxonomy_code + primary_taxonomy_code_label (per NPPES Readme v.2 sec. 1.1: primary is a per-NPI fact, not a per-taxonomy attribute).

code_label.description: NUCC 'Display Name' for the code. Populated by provider_record_builder from the NUCC catalog.

primary_taxonomy_code.description: The single NUCC taxonomy code NPPES designates as the provider's primary specialty. Lifted from the NPPES per-slot Primary Taxonomy Switch columns by normalize_provider_rows. LLD v39 sec. 7.1.

primary_taxonomy_code_label.description: Human-readable label for primary_taxonomy_code. NUCC 'Display Name' populated by provider_record_builder.

licenses.description: Optional. Omitted when NPPES reported no license slots.

state.description: US state abbreviation where the license was issued.

state_label.description: Full state name for the two-letter state code (LLD v39 sec. 7.1).

number.description: License number as reported by the provider to CMS.

other_identifiers.description: Legacy or alternate provider identifiers (UPIN, Medicaid, Medicare OSCAR, payer-issued IDs, etc.). One object per identifier slot from NPPES; type_description is derived from type_code via the OID_TYPE_DESCRIPTIONS dictionary. Includes insurance-bearing facts (Medicaid IDs, named-issuer fields like 'BLUE SHIELD') that are consumer-facing signals about which insurance a provider takes.

identifier.description: The identifier value as reported in NPPES.

type_code.description: Type code as reported in NPPES. Two-character string. Common values: '01' = Other, '05' = Medicaid.

type_description.description: Human-readable type label derived from type_code via OID_TYPE_DESCRIPTIONS. Present when type_code is in the dictionary.

state.description: State associated with this identifier (e.g. the state that issued a state Medicaid ID).

issuer.description: Issuing organization. Free-form string from NPPES.

bad_data.description: Set when a provider record fails a data-quality gate. Present only when flagged. Permanent until source data is corrected.

flagged.description: True when the record is flagged.

reason.description: Why the record was flagged. Controlled vocabulary (CV-001 bad_data_reasons).

out_of_scope.description: Set when a provider record is currently excluded from operational scope (deactivated, foreign, etc.). Optional; absence means in-scope. See also the `active` event log which captures any historical inactivity even when not currently flagged.

flagged.description: True when the record is currently excluded.

reason.description: Why the record is currently excluded. Controlled vocabulary (CV-002 out_of_scope_reasons).

can_prescribe.description: True if any of this provider's NUCC taxonomies has prescribing authority per the proprietary catalog (ProprietaryData.SpecialtyAndProviderFlags). OR across taxonomies. entity_type_code='2' (organization) short-circuits to false. Computed by provider_flags_enrichment.compute_provider_flags.

is_homeopathic.description: True if any of this provider's NUCC taxonomies is classified as homeopathic per the proprietary catalog. OR across taxonomies. entity_type_code='2' (organization) short-circuits to false.

is_disqualified.description: From ProprietaryData.SpecialtyAndProviderFlags (F-006) per NUCC taxonomy. entity_type_code='2' not applicable.

provider_last_name_legal_name.description: Provider's legal last name as registered with CMS. Typically present on individual records (entity_type_code = '1').

provider_first_name.description: Provider's first name. Typically present on individual records.

provider_sex_code.description: Provider sex as reported to CMS.

provider_sex_code_label.description: Human-readable label for provider_sex_code (LLD v39 sec. 7.1).

is_sole_proprietor.description: Whether the individual provider operates as a sole proprietor ('Y'/'N'). Typically present on individual records.

is_sole_proprietor_label.description: Human-readable label for is_sole_proprietor (LLD v39 sec. 7.1).

provider_organization_name_legal_busines.description: Legal business name of the organization. Typically present on organization records (entity_type_code = '2').

provider_other_organization_name.description: Alternate or DBA name for the organization.

employer_identification_number_ein.description: Federal EIN for the organization. May be '<UNAVAIL>' if CMS could not obtain it.

is_organization_subpart.description: Whether this organization is a subpart of a larger organization ('Y'/'N').

parent_organization_lbn.description: Legal business name of the parent organization.

parent_organization_tin.description: Tax Identification Number of the parent organization.

authorized_official_last_name.description: Last name of the authorized official responsible for the NPI record.

authorized_official_first_name.description: First name of the authorized official.

authorized_official_middle_name.description: Middle name of the authorized official.

authorized_official_title_or_position.description: Job title or position of the authorized official.

authorized_official_telephone_number.description: Phone number of the authorized official. Digits only, no formatting.

authorized_official_credential_text.description: Professional credential of the authorized official.

embedding.description: Vector embedding of the provider record for semantic search.

embedding_text.description: Text source used to generate the embedding. Should match the user-facing rendering of the provider so the embedding's semantic space encodes what the user actually sees.

embedding_model.description: Identifier of the embedding model used (e.g. 'text-embedding-3-large').

embedding_version.description: Version stamp of the embedding pipeline that produced this vector.

allOf.description: Type 1 individual practitioners: name + sex + sole-proprietor flag required (100% presence in NPPES sampling).

Type 2 organizations: organization name + EIN + authorized-official quartet + is_organization_subpart required (100% presence in NPPES sampling). Nested: if is_organization_subpart='Y', parent_organization_lbn and parent_organization_tin become required (100% co-occurrence in NPPES sampling — 7,522/7,522 subpart records carried both; 0/10,000 non-subpart records carried either).

address.title: Address
address.description: A US address as reported in the NPPES NPI registry. Used inside the provider's `addresses` array; discriminated by address_type ('business' = the NPPES mailing/billing address, 'practice' = a practice location). Carries a nested county sub-document populated by the county enrichment passes (Pass 1 ZIP crosswalk + Census batch + Census billing + NPPES registry + Google Maps fallback) and an urban flag derived from USDA Rural-Urban Continuum Codes.

address_type.description: Discriminator. 'business' = the NPPES mailing/billing address (exactly one per provider). 'practice' = the NPPES primary practice location. 'secondary_practice' = a practice location appended from pl_pfile_*.csv. 'mailing' = legacy alias occasionally present.

state.description: Two-letter US state or territory abbreviation.

state_label.description: Full state name for the two-letter state code (LLD v39 sec. 7.1).

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code. Stored as a string to preserve leading zeros. Truncated from any ZIP+4 input at parse time.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. 'US' for domestic providers. Foreign values trigger out_of_scope with reason 'foreign_provider'.

country_code_label.description: Full country name for the ISO country code (LLD v39 sec. 7.1).

phone.description: Phone number as reported by NPPES. Digits only or with formatting as received.

fax.description: Fax number as reported by NPPES.

county.description: County enrichment result for this specific address. Populated by the county enrichment passes regardless of address_type — business addresses get county/urban stamped the same as practice addresses.

county.title: CountyEnrichment
county.description: Result of the county enrichment pipeline for one address. Nested under each entry in the provider's `addresses` array. Includes a derived urban flag from USDA Rural-Urban Continuum Codes (RUCC 1-3 → urban=true, RUCC 4-9 → urban=false).

fips.description: 5-digit FIPS county code (2-digit state + 3-digit county). Null when enrichment failed (source carries one of the geocoder_pass*_failed labels) or the address is excluded (out_of_scope*). Example: '30063' = Missoula County, MT.

name.description: Human-readable county name (e.g. 'Missoula County'). Present when fips is set via crosswalk or Maps. Absent for some sources (e.g. Census batch geocoder does not return county name).

source.description: Which enrichment pass assigned the county. Determines reliability and method of the assignment. Deterministic — no separate 'reason' is needed except for the out_of_scope_zip_state_mismatch case captured in the `reason` field below.

x-enum-descriptions.crosswalk_pass1: ZIP -> county via ZipCountyCrosswalk (res_ratio >= 0.98). Fastest path, ~82% of providers.
x-enum-descriptions.crosswalk_zip_fixed: ZIP crosswalk applied after zip_state_mismatch detection corrected the state.
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass2_batch: U.S. Census Geocoder batch API on practice address.
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass2_batch_billing: U.S. Census Geocoder batch API on practice address with mailing fallback (legacy combined Pass 2 path).
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass2_failed: Pass 2 (Census batch on practice address) gave up. Recovery resumes at pass 3.
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass3_billing: U.S. Census Geocoder batch API on mailing/billing address (Pass 2 fallback).
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass3_failed: Pass 3 (Census batch on billing address) gave up. Recovery resumes at pass 4.
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass4_maps: Google Maps Geocoding API on practice address. Paid API.
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass4_failed: Pass 4 (Google Maps on practice address) gave up. Recovery resumes at pass 6.
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass5_maps_billing: Google Maps Geocoding API on billing address. Paid API.
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass6_nppes: NPI looked up in NPPES registry; returned address tried against ZIP crosswalk.
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass6_failed: Pass 6 (NPPES last-resort) gave up. Chain exhausted; address remains un-countyed until the next monthly pipeline run.
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_no_address: Address has no usable line1 / city to geocode.
x-enum-descriptions.out_of_scope: Address (or provider) excluded from enrichment. See 'reason' for the criterion.
x-enum-descriptions.out_of_scope_zip_state_mismatch: This address's ZIP does not match its state and license-based repair did not resolve it.

reason.description: Why this address's county could not be computed. Present only when source = 'out_of_scope' or 'out_of_scope_zip_state_mismatch'. Records the specific failure mode of the zip-state-mismatch repair attempt.

zip_ratio.description: Residential population ratio of the ZIP→county mapping used (0.0 - 1.0). Pulled from ZipCountyCrosswalk.res_ratio. 1.0 = the ZIP is entirely within this county; <1.0 = split-ZIP where the ratio is the fraction of residents in THIS county vs others the ZIP also covers. Present only when source = 'crosswalk_pass1' or 'crosswalk_zip_fixed'.

urban.description: Urban-vs-rural classification of the county. True = urban (USDA Rural-Urban Continuum Code 1-3). False = rural (RUCC 4-9). Derived from USDA Ruralurbancontinuumcodes2023.xlsx per EPIC-010-F-007-S-011-REQ-T-002.
